review_description: I’d like to thank SAE for an excellent installation. The sales rep was a standout from the other quotes I received. He was polite, informed and easy to talk to. No spin just solid information and a great manner about him. I purchased a 20kw battery system that has run like clockwork. The Neovolt app is also excellent and I can check on the system from home or away. The app provides all the information I need and is really easy to use and understand. The installation was top notch electricians and did a great job. They answered every single question I had and were a delight to have on the job. The site was left completely clean and everything has just worked perfectly. I would highly recommend SAE for anyone looking for a battery system. I have not drawn a single kW from the grid since the installation (via the app’s info) and will be very keen to get my next electricity bill to see the changes.Very kind regardsStuart Kerridge, Woolgoolga NSW

I ultimately decided to go with SAE Group because of Adam who designed our system. Out of the five quotes I received he was the most willing to work with me on designing a system that was exactly what I wanted. A number of the other quotes we received looked good on paper and I imagine would be perfectly servicable, but didn't quite meet my needs (battery location, size of battery, size of inverter, quality of panels etc.).From when we paid the deposit to having the panels on our roof was about 8 weeks. I did have to chase up SAE Group to book in my installation, but once it was booked it was smooth sailing. The installers were a sub-contracted company called Coastal Solar, who worked efficiently and were able to complete the majority of the installation in one day. There were a couple of minor issues, they forgot to upgrade the RCBO switches in my fuse box, but once promted returned the next day to complete the job. There was one light on the circuit that was wired incorrectly, but once identified the installer returned a few days later and was able to rectify the issue.I removed a star for having to have two return visits to complete and remediate the job, but the Coastal Solar installers were extremely professional, kept the site clean and were very respectful. Bailey and the team did a great job, so I would recommend their workmanship. They also managed to complete the installation with only one broken tile, which wasn't an issue.I am very happy with the system overall and the iSolarCloud application is relatively user-friendly. There are a few settings that were a little convoluted to implement but I am very happy with the system. SAE Group also submitted all of the paperwork to get out meter upgraded to a Smart Meter in a timely manner. Despite the steep cost (approximately $6,000 more than the cheapest quote we received) I would strongly recommend SAE Group for people looking to get exactly the system they want, not just the system the installer wants to sell.

Sales and quoting were easy and obliging.  Did multiple quotes for different battery sizes.Install was quick and painless.  Installed tested and handed over in 4 hoursCompany service was mostly good, although they failed to call me back on a couple of occasions after they promised they would.

The sales staff were very through and explained the process well. The installation team were very professional and had to put a lot of effort in. Very happy with the finished install and the working of the system.
Great customer service with clear communication and great install. I also chased them for more info post install and they were very helpful. Very happy.

Sales and quoting could have been better. Price figures were changing at random. Had purchased a 30kw battery, weeks after depositing for the 30kw, received late night text to say could not do the 30kw, and had to make a choice of 25 or 40. Sales person promised phone call, often never received them. Difficult to actually talk to Mark. Had far better  experience with sales than this.Installation process was excellent, installers excellent -  very polite andfriendly. They were very tidy and punctual, system / battery was fullyfunctional prior to them leaving. Instructions were given.

I already had a solar PV system and was only wanting to add batteries.The salesman was great - listened to what I wanted and provided options.  A disappointment was the 2-week delay getting a contract - they didn't have a specific battery contract.  After signing the contract the wait time for installation was given as 4-6 weeks, but indicated it should be the shorter period given the delay with getting a contract.  I followed up after 6 weeks and was told another 4 weeks.  I contacted the salesman, who had been on leave, and the installation was arranged for early the following week.The installers were also great - friendly, helpful and obliging.  There were issues - one of the inverters wasn't working correctly and a light circuit didn't connect, but they were promptly rectified.  The electrician and apprentice both were knowledgeable, professional and efficient.  They took the time to provide me information and advice on the batteries and inverters they had installed.SAE have followed up on how the installation went.

I added 6.6kW of panels to an existing solar system, plus a 16kWh battery and upgraded inverter. SAE were great to work with. They answered all of my questions quickly and clearly explained the  pros and cons of different options. Products installed are good quality, midrange options. Installers were punctual, friendly and tidy.
I was very happy with everyone involved with the installation of my battery. This is the 3rd time I have used SAE and would do so again in the future

SAE was easy to work with, prompt, professional & Tyson explained the job  so I understood the process without concern.The installation on the day was quick & efficient & Marcelo explained the workings of the battery & set the app for me.This is the third time SAE has installed jobs for me & I couldn’t be happier to recommend them.
SAE were patient, informed and thorough from all stages of design and guiding through to installation. They did a great job! Highly recommend!
Battery install was very efficient, quick, 4 hours, kept me informed all the way though. Great job all round. Very pleased with whole system.
Installation company was great - they were on time & easy to deal with and questions were answered on the spot.
Great communication, considered advice, kept to dates and the installation went perfectly. Highly recommend.

The whole process of getting solar installed was a breeze with SAE. I had multiple quotes and found SAE quote to be the best with top quality panels and inverter.  The electricians who installed the system where very efficient, on time and cleaned up after themselves prior to leaving. Highly recommend SAE from the sales team, installers and communication.
Deposit paid awaiting installation. SAE provided a comprehensive quote with options as well as a detailed explanation of the Battery system

The salesman was informative and friendly.The installation was on time and clean and tidy.The customer service people were very helpful,I assume the connection is on the grid because the app shows power going back to the grid.I have not been shown how to use the charger I was handed a booklet and I am still needing to get that advice.

We had used SAE a decade ago for our original solar panel installation and chose to use them again for a battery wall based on our positive dealings with them. The sales person was so easy to deal with and did a superb job of helping us understand everything on offer. They accommodated our later start date to fit in with renovations already underway. The installation itself was seamless and we opted to update all of our solar panels as well. We are so happy with the results as we are producing more power than we ever anticipated. Thank you SAE. We highly recommend your company.
The quoting process was great hasn't been installed yet still waiting for Energex to put my address on the grid
From initial enquiry to installation the whole team at SAE group were knowledgable and had great customer service. Couldn’t be happier - thank you SAE
The installer was efficient and communicated well SAE need to pat themselves on the back

Have had 2 systems installed by SAE. The second system was to reduce our power bills further and be battery ready when costs became more reasonable. Unfortunately our bills did not go down with the second system because only one system exports to the grid and the other system is limited to what we use from it. If our usage exceeds what this system produces we have to buy it from the grid even though our other system is producing enough energy to cover our needs. Essentially we give power to the grid from this system and buy it back for $0.30kw. No sensible explanation has been provided and I believe the installation is at fault.

Tyson was fantastic explaining the options available. Adam was fantastic following up with problems associated with the age of the house. Of course Meg was the star of the team coordinating the whole installation and follow-up. A pleasure to do business with.

The sales process with Andrew was fantastic, he was always available to answer any questions I had and if he even if it meant he promptly called me back because he missed the call.The installation team was fantastic, even took the trouble to slightly lift the unit after they had already attached it to the wall at my request which was greatly appreciated.The knowledge imparted during the installation was impecable and really helped me understand how the system was going to operate, there is a reason we have continued to use SAE Group for all three solar installations we have undertaken (the initial install, expansion of the panels and upgrade of the invertor and finally replacement of the invertor with a Tesla PowerWall 3).Will 100% be using them again when we add the second battery.

The SAE group have been brilliant from the first contact with Mark the salesman who’s knowledge and experience helped us choose the best system for our needs to the office staff who kept us informed of the pending installation and finally the installation team of Tanguy, Asher and Pat who were absolutely brilliant and delivered a very professional job nothing seemed to be too much trouble for them. So if you want to help the planet and lower your carbon footprint the people at the SAE group are the ones to see.

Quotes wher great and they adapted well to the NSW changes after original quote.June was the programmed install date , unfortunately supply caused many false starts, eventually installed September.Installation team where great, noting a location issue on arrival inspection, with good consultation resolved to everyone’s satisfaction.Job was completed in the time frame, and in a planned manner.Site cleaned and instructions on battery app and Gateway operation good.Out of the three quotes SAE where the most attentive to our questions and needs.
The installation from the quote to the installation was very professional and problem free.
All went well and as expected.  Came when booked and left tidy

Good information provided. Install at day and time as quoted. Installation was well done.Needs clarity around the process to upgrade to digital electricity box ie who contacts who and arranges this. Before or after install?The iSolar app is good when it works - but goes offline regularly

Adam and Brad right on time as scheduled. Told me how things were going to happen regarding outages, important as my wife WFH. Very efficient setup, explained app and blackout process, love the app, very informative. Luke the sales guy was great to talk to, very straight and honest with quotes and details. Would recommend you talk to SAE before signing elsewhere. Very happy with whole 30kw plus inverter package.

My experience with the sales team was good. I am an Electrical Engineer  and had the experience of having solar panels for over 15 years. The handover was just O.K. with quite a lot NOT explained, I have managed to bumble my way through. I had trouble last time with the panel wiring lying in the troughs of my roof where they impeded the leaves that accumulated. I did stress to the sales team that I wanted this problem fixed in he new installation, and it was. Another problem was the old screw holes through the roof and the contractor did not seem to interested in talking about this, I do hope his experience is right. i have not had the time to get up on the roof and check that part of the install.

The team at SAE were excellent to deal with.  They made the effort to follow up all inquiries I had.  The installation team were courteous and professional and completed the job exceptionally well.  Highly recommended.

Great service pre install and post from SAE for my solar and battery system. The installation crew were very efficient and knowledgeable. They tidied the site and were happy to answer all my questions before they left. Immediate follow up from the office next day checking everything was okay.

Eight years ago, we had our first SAE Group solar system installed and it never missed a beat. But we decided it was time to upgrade to a larger system with a battery to get even more out of solar.We chose 19.11kW SunPower panels, a 10kW Sungrow hybrid inverter and a 25kWh battery—and we’re so glad we did.From the very first step, the process was amazing. Everything was explained clearly and handled with professionalism. On installation day, Ryan and his team arrived right on time, worked efficiently, kept everything tidy and were a pleasure to deal with. They also took the time to walk us through the new system, which made the transition easy and stress-free.What’s been most surprising is how being able to monitor the system has changed the way we use power at home. We’re now much more aware of when and how we use energy, and it’s helping us get the absolute best out of both the panels and the battery.It’s a fantastic upgrade and we couldn’t recommend SAE Group highly enough.
Efficient installation by friendly staff. Area left spotlessly clean and tidy.

SAE Group customer service staff and installers were outstanding. They regularly checked in with details of the installation and ensured all details were checked and double checked. Even with all the rain, they kept me informed as to when they would return to complete the installation.The sales quoting and process was easy as they explained everything in detail along with providing clear timeframes for installation. The team helped with the APP installation and helped organise the grid connection after installation.We highly recommend SAE Group Pty Ltd if you are thinking of installing or replacing your solar. I would definitely use them again.

All talk.Take your money.Poor design, no professional follow up after design.Don't listen to the requests of the client.Conflicting information on documentation.Non completion of requests.Signed in May 2025 still waiting in August 2025 for things to get finalised.
Very good experience with SAE solar from the start to completion. Very happy and satisfied.
Very professional, punctual and knowledge about the product they were installing.And were helpful in explaining the battery installation and setting up and explaining the app.

Sales process was clear and consultative and helped us land on a solution suitable for our needsInstallation team was very polite and professional.  they had to consider best options for battery locations and consulted clearly.  Following installation of the battery, assisted with getting the app and showed how to use it.  explained how the battery operates.  excellent and trouble free

Overall a great result.Task was to retrofit existing 15kW system with 26kWh battery.Like all technical services, the more you know in advance, the better the result - especially with sizing the system and locating the equipment. Ask questions.Installation team was great and very cooperative.The end result was very professionally completed.The job was only marred when they had to return to complete the job. It took 3 attempts for them to return - main reason was due to getting hung up on other jobs schedules before. If the technicians do need to reschedule, make sure the appointment is first in the morning!
The sales process with Nathan went really well so did the actual installation. Dates were a bit more tricky but in the end everything went really well.
Well organised from sales to install which was tidy and delivered on time and without fuss.

Sales process worked well and happy with process and feedback along the way, Nathan kept me well informed.Installation process was professional and completed in the day.Preparation for installation took some time and mixed messages re pre site visit, though eventually worked out well.Team showed me the important parts of system prior to completion on the day.Since the install I have had some issue with meter and electricity provider setting up account so i can change my plan. Provider having previously advised I have a smart meter having to plan some work related to the meter - origin energy??I had the meter upgraded 2 years ago to allow for smarter billing to be enabled and now they have to work out if it can do solar??Otherwise good process for me

Initial installation went reasonably smooth.However,  some 6 months after installation I wanted to upgrade my battery capacity from 20 to 30 kWh. Technical knowledge of SAE office staff was not great providing quotes for systems that simply are not possible.  Had to settle for a 25kwh upgrade.More recently I reported two problems and after some 4 weeks I still have no answers to my issues.Very disappointing after sales service!!!

Update - 3/11/25After 4 months my Solar has been installed, Adam and his team of installers were great, arrived on time, completed the work professionally and were very helpful.I was given Emily from the office who worked through all my initial frustrations, and it was so good to have the communication open, she had organised and communicated for a follow up visit to help sort out my app/wifi connection.I am really happy with the solar installed.I am still waiting for the install, signed in May, and resigned in June ( due to changes in govt rebate) was told  4 weeks in May, 4 weeks in June then finally in July after chasing up was told there is a delay in the supply of the battery, have tried to email ( last email 17th July) still waiting for a responseSales process was quick and helpfulInstallation - still waitingCustomer service - lacking after signing the contract and as I am still

The installers arrived at the time organised and the install was a very professional job the site was left clean and tidy when they finished and they explained how the system worked before they leftWould definitely recommend SAEGreat Job

Excellent service in every respect with great advice, professional and on-time installation, top quality inverter and battery, assistance setting up and explaining the system and app. Perfect install!
From the first conversation with Toby till after the installation the project was done quickly and efficiently
Great customer service, install and product knowledge from SAE happy to recommend if required thank you SAE Group.
Their pricing was very competitive, communication first class and the guys worked efficiently and were very tidy.
Everything went well from quoting to installation. Very happy with Solar Quotes and SAE

We’re really happy with the service and install by SAE.Communication was great throughout the quoting and booking of install. They were really patient with us while we waited for our roof restoration to be complete prior to install.The install team were great to deal with, and their attention to detail was really appreciated.
1. Quoting was professional.2. Installation was excellent.3. Unable to rate post sale customer service as it has yet to happen! Still waiting for rebate documentation
Good quality product at a very competitive cost, a very efficient and neat installation.System performing very well as it should.Happy with choice of company for purchase / installation.

I found SAE great to deal with from the outset. All involved have been communicative,  flexible and professional.  I made some last minute changes and they were more than happy to accommodate.  I would definitely recommend them.

I had a very positive experience with SAE Group, right from the initial contact through to the installation.  Their salesperson listened to my requirements and provided excellent recommendations.  They ultimately recommended a first class solution at a very fair price.  The scheduling and installation of the system was also a very positive experience. The installation team did a great job, including cleaning up after they finished.  I highly recommend SAE Group and am glad that Solar Quotes directed me to them.

Given the scramble that the current battery installation market, I selected to choose from reputable installers.  The firm I chose had good quality products at a reasonable price.Importantly, the firm listened to me (as against tried to 'educate' me fit their range of products).

The initial sales call was with a solar system design engineer & battery specialist who asked very specific questions regarding our home/work schedule, power usage, any plans for future home development and appetite for cost effectiveness vs quality of system. This person gave me great confidence I was getting the best system for my needs. I had a few questions regarding some of the components and how they compared to some of the other options they could provide that were a bit cheaper or more expensive and the salesperson explained in relatable detail why for my needs that the system that was selected  was the best value for money.Installation went smoothly, the installers worked efficiently, were polite and cleaned up after themselves. They offered to replace a few already cracked roof tiles and recommended I replace my roof tile mortar as it had deteriorated and could allow water leaks into the roof. The team leader explained to me the next steps of the process now that my system had been installed, helped me download the Solar interface smartphone app and sign in and gave me a thorough run down of the inverter.

Whole process was and has been easy. Polite, punctual and professional. Sales and quoting was great process guided by knowledgeable staff. Grid connection was organised in a good timely manner and done well. Batteries have been ordered and deposit paid. Expecting same excellent service.
Mostly good.The installation itself was quick and efficient apart from them having to return to complete it a few days later.
Fast response to initial enquiry. Offered multiple options and a full breakdown of benefits for each. Installed panels and battery in under 1 day. Great company, would use again for sure!

The sales process was quite helpful and provided information initially  as required . The quoted price seemed reasonable at the time. (has proven to be not such a great deal).Nevertheless the tradesmen completed the installation smoothly, and once on site, efficiently and tidily.While I was given a good run-down following installation, it was probably “information overload”. Not really able to absorb all at once. Probably could have done with follow up info!Also not really sure that we are optimising use - or how to do that.What is there to know about VPP.

Having the battery installed was an easy process from the get go. The guy who came around, gave honest and factual advice on whether it was actually even worth my money to get a battery.  And he admitted at that point of time it was borderline being able to pay for itself over it's lifetime for my power usage. Having said that, I decided to go with a battery, as a way of helping the environment, and it does help with cash flow as your electricity bill becomes so minuscule without making lifestyle changes to use your solar generated power efficiently. The SAE team gave me an estimated date, of installation and price, as it was the start of NSW subsidies. And both came out better than expected considering our crazy weather this year. The installation team were very professional, punctual and even bit of a comedy duo when you got talking to them. But really when it all comes down to it, a battery doesn't change your life, it really just sits there in the corner doing it's own thing. The only thing it changes is your footprint in the environment and your bill, and when the power goes out in your street, you can stand at your window and laugh at your neighbours as bit of a bonus.

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but I feel I need to share my experience with SAE Solar to hopefully help others make an informed choice.We had solar panels installed by SAE. Not long after, we noticed a roof leak directly under where the panels were installed. What started as a small issue quickly turned into significant internal damage to our ceiling due to the significant amount of rain we have had over the last few months.I contacted them straight away, but it took over a month—and several follow-up emails—before anyone even got back to me. I only received a proper response after escalating things and mentioning I’d be lodging formal complaints. That really shouldn’t be necessary just to get someone to take responsibility.A technician finally came out in early May, but since then I’ve been stuck chasing answers. I’ve followed up multiple times, even assisting in arranging a local builder to do the repair work, but weeks later I’m still waiting for a decision or timeline.The installation itself might have been fine, but the customer service and aftercare have been extremely disappointing. If something goes wrong, you want a company that takes ownership and communicates properly. Unfortunately, that hasn’t been my experience with SAE Solar.

Quotation process was goodInstallation was goodAfter sales service when we have had system failures, incl. 1 just 1 month after installation was nonexistent. with no afterhours contact available & delays in repairs with no parts on hand.Even during work hours to be able to speak to someone direct with any knowledge was like extracting teeth.I have wasted so much time with SAE over faults & problems I would never recommend them.I should have used a local company
They could not have done anything better from our first meeting till the after service we received.

Settings on Generator incorrect. Not SAE's fault4. After installation, cover of fuse box fell off. Broken hinges.5. Internal wiring of fuse box was disgusting and rats nest squeezed into box6. So bad unable to traced connections of wiring7. Monitoring system reported Phase 1 incorrectly. ZERO CurrentPhases 2 & 3 reported correctly. Direct measurements on Phase 1 were correct8. Problem still not resolved

My solar panels are trapping a large amount of leaves beneath them which is difficult to clean. I tried contacting SAE by email and phone. After finally getting a response I was informed a technician would require to inspect my installation for a fee. I have paid the fee of $340 on the 14th May and have heard nothing since.I will now have to begin chasing SAE to get something done, something that I have already paid for!After Sales Service is obviously not a priority for SAE!

Fantastic Installer, no issues with the system provided and installed a year ago. Quality equipment and produces exactly what SAE advised us the system would generate. Recommend SAE Group! Would use them again in the future if I need to upgrade.

Very good to do business with always on time all staff are very helpful and courteous. Neat and tidy installations, they explain all about the equipment in easy to understand information and how to login on the computer to see system running.

Good quote and easy to chat to. Installation was quick and easy and they were very polite and punctual about the whole thing. Showed us how to use the whole system and great to talk to if there are any issues.
Sales process + manager was great. Had his own SAE PV system also so had great insights / feedback on the options and where the best value is - eg inverter, tree shading etc etc.

I purchased an off grid system from SAE 5 years ago as it was going to cost in excess of $50,000 to connect to the grid for the privilege of receiving a quarterly bill. The off grid system was a no brainer and it has been operating reliably and constantly since the date of purchase. The installation of the panels, hardware and batteries went seamlessly and the customer experience was professional and helpful. I highly recommend this solar energy provider.

Whole process was very smooth from initial quote to install and a great price for a good system of roof top solar.Tyson through to the install guys were good and whole area was tidied up after the install. Great run through of the system and the appAll working really well.Thanks SAE

We have been a long-term customer and during that time have had great support. We were only just speaking about this this morning over a coffee with friends and commenting on the fact that they are a trusted company and helpful with any enquiries during our association with you.

Our Sungrow inverter and Sunpower solar panels were installed in 2020 in our fully electric house and we have received $ Electricity Quarterly Credits ever since. Sale advice, installation advice and customer service all excellent.

Our home had sustained substantial damage following a hail storm . Apia our insurer paid to have our house roof repaired and gave us a settlement for remaining repairs .We had an existing 5 Kw Solar System that had been installed by the SAE Group . A Thermal scan revealed that the panels , although visually intact ; were compromised and needed to be replaced . We were on a healthy feed in tariff and were aware that although tempted to power our system up  risked a drop in tariff rate .The SAE Group helped us with our decision making and we had them install a 4.8Kw Solar System. Removal of the old and installation of the new had to be coordinated with our tiled roof repairs and the work was completed in a timely manner and without fuss.The SAE Group sent me an email during Cyclone Alfred advising us to leave our Solar System switched on. This conflicted with much messaging in the media and gave us the comfort to leave it take care of itself.We now have the ability to monitor our solar system status on line and are enjoying life as pensioners without a power bill .

SAE have just finished installation of two Neovolt 10 kWhr batteries.  The location was a very visible area near a verandah.  Andrew and team did a great job.  Very neat and a positive layout that does not detract from the location.Early days in the performance but so far so good.

This is our third home we have had Solar and air conditioning installed by SAE.Sales rep was very informative, giving us assurance and direction for our systems.Installation was efficient, punctual and tidy always informing us throughout process.Couldn’t be happier with systems installed each time and the customer service provided with education and support and reassurance.

The complete process with SAE Group was professional, efficient and cost competitive. The sales representative Mark Horley was extremely knowledgeable and he did not attempt to sell us more than we needed but instead designed a system which was ideally suited to our needs. The installation by Arthur and his team was rapid and professional, completed in one day, despite being told initially that it could take two days. Our old system was removed and recycled by SAE as part of the cost. I can highly recommend SAE group.
I really have appreciated the after sale service!! Any questions or problem after the installation has been a breeze!!!
Tidy, timely and professional. Would use again to add a battery if price is right

Home Battery Storage added, Quality product at a very competitive price.Expertly Installed, neat wiring layout.Systems capabilities fully explained and understood.Shutdown and startup proceedures fully explained and demonstrated.

Whilst it was slow to get the process started the service and communication was spot on. All the  people I had contact with were honest and upfront.Site was left clean and tidyBattery issues were promptly attended and contact maintained until working.
Efficient and on time, the installation was neat and the gear works a treat.

From the very beginning on quoting, through installation and follow up everything from SAE has been wonderful.All staff were very polite and efficient and we appreciated the extra information given to us as this was our first ever solar installation.Highly recommend SAE!
Easy process, fast and well explained.  Also the booking process for installation.

Chose SAE via Solaquotes, amazing service, easy every step of the way always kept informed.  On install day I was not on site so the installer facetimed with me to discuss, so pleased, great system generating lots of power with an app to see live just how well it’s performing.  Love it

Tyson was great to deal with for the quote/acceptance . Process was seamless with allocation of the install date .Install team of Arthur and Drew were great explaining the install plan and getting the job done . All tidy on completion and good explanation of inverter reporting .Thank you for a great experience and future power bill savings

I had an exceptional experience with SAE. Their reputation for high-quality solar panels and inverters, particularly the Sunpower Maxeon panels and Fronius inverters we selected (42 and 2 x 10kW respectively), was certainly upheld. The sales process was remarkably smooth, thanks to a knowledgeable and approachable representative. The installation team was equally impressive – highly skilled, efficient, and demonstrating unparalleled workmanship. Their punctuality was also appreciated. Furthermore, the customer service team was consistently helpful and responsive. As a first-time solar customer, I especially valued their guidance through the grid connection process. I wholeheartedly recommend SAE.
Sales and quoting process was efficient and informative.Installation guys were polite, tidy and punctual. They explained the battery workings well after installation.
I had a great experience with SAE. Our sales rep was lovely, and our install team was very efficient. I look forward to using them again when we get our second battery.
Great service, excellent product throughly recommended, product and service after service also great.
The electrician was first class. Knew his stuff.

The salesman was extremely helpful with his suggestions and Ideas.The installers very friendly.  Happy to have these installers to chat and ask questions. So HELPFUL. Turned up on time and cleaned up after themselves.Everything was explained to me before they left the premises. Installation of the app and what to do

Bought a solar system with battery and panels because I would rather pay off the system than have a power bill each month. My install was tricker than usual with a 3 story terrace townhouse and limited spaces where the battery inverter could go. Single phase power so didn’t want to over invest, and couldn’t be bothered being a trading Barron with amber energy. Wanted a battery because I use a lot of air con overnight and the price made sense.SAE had a best range of products, combinations, advice. Easy finance option. I got a special with neovolt & seraphim panels pre Christmas, paid a bit more because of the scissor lift for install which is normal, safer and faster for everyone. Went with top of the range panels with 40 year warranty because that’s the trickiest install, then figure the battery will need replacing in 10-15 years so that’s where I could be more budget conscious in this scenario. SAE sales and service were great and understood the assignment. I Cannot recommend highly enough. They provided after service check ins to make sure everything was working and the smart meter and energy retailer stuff was taking care of. Ran through how to use on the day.It’s been 3 months: my system is 99% self sufficient meaning bills are tiny or credits and what I used to pay to the energy retailer is now the fixed rate green loan payment in the short term.Everything even stood up in the recent cyclone, no issues.

We engaged SAE group to install two Tesla 2 batteries at our premises. So their approach has always been to treat it as an opportunity to teach us, but also to learn more for themselves. Everyone has a question they have not been asked before, or some issues with understanding the tech stuff. Sometimes I had to ask again.
